comparison.method: Read each file independently with pxr.Sdf.Layer. Compare every traversed path and authored field using typed value equality, and complete ExportToString outputs without stripping or normalizing any field.

result: Both exact binary exports decode to identical authored USD content in the checked OpenUSD implementation. Arbitrary same-name files remain rejected.
scope: Static complete-layer comparison; not a policy-score reproduction or a complete fresh-machine task installation.
distribution: Acquisition code and this record are published; the third-party USD payload remains external and subject to its upstream terms.
